components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a local task or panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary, #c99a45); color: var(--primary-foreground, #18130b); font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #c99a45) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #c99a45) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A compact secondary action that remains subordinate to the current content.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #30343b); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background, #111214); color: var(--foreground, #e8e9ec); font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #202227); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #c99a45) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A reversible toolbar or contextual action with no resting container.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5.36px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1); transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, #202227); color: var(--foreground, #e8e9ec); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #c99a45) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

components.name: Asset Search
components.description: The primary workspace search field with compact icon affordances.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; width: 360px; max-width: 100%; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 12px; width: 14px; height: 14px; transform: translateY(-50%); fill: none; stroke: var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 36px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--input, #383d45); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, #202227) 20%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #e8e9ec); padding: 0 32px 0 36px; font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring, #c99a45); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #c99a45) 50%, transparent); } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

components.name: Library Navigation Item
components.description: A sidebar destination with a technical count and restrained selected state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 220px; height: 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1); text-align: left; font: 400 12px/16px var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-nav-item span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-item code { color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1) 70%, transparent); font: 400 11px/16px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--muted, #202227); color: var(--foreground, #e8e9ec); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #25272c); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #f0f0f2); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #c99a45) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Asset Card
components.description: The signature grid item: preview first, compact identity and technical metadata second.
components.css: .ds-asset-card { position: relative; width: 156px; min-width: 0; display: block; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #c99a45) 3.5%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #e8e9ec); text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-asset-preview { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #c99a45) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; background-color: #191b1f; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg,#22252a 25%,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(-45deg,#22252a 25%,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 75%,#22252a 75%),linear-gradient(-45deg,transparent 75%,#22252a 75%); background-position: 0 0,0 6px,6px -6px,-6px 0; background-size: 12px 12px; } .ds-asset-preview svg { width: 30px; height: 30px; fill: none; stroke: var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1); stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-asset-card strong { display: block; margin-top: 6px; overflow: hidden; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, #e8e9ec) 90%, transparent); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-asset-meta { margin-top: 2px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1); white-space: nowrap; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-asset-meta code { font: inherit; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-asset-meta i { font-style: normal; } .ds-asset-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, #e8e9ec) 12%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, #202227) 25%, transparent); } .ds-asset-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #c99a45) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Applied Tag Chip
components.description: A compact removable classification or organization value.
components.css: .ds-tag-chip { height: 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5.36px; background: var(--secondary, #22252a); color: var(--secondary-foreground, #e0e1e4); font: 400 11px/16px var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-tag-chip svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-tag-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--secondary, #22252a), var(--foreground, #e8e9ec) 5%); color: var(--foreground, #e8e9ec); } .ds-tag-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-tag-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #c99a45) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Task Dialog
components.description: A compact modal task boundary with a structurally separated action footer.
components.html:
Forget this pack?

Lootbox removes its index entries but leaves every source file untouched.
components.css: .ds-dialog { position: relative; width: 352px; max-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 13.28px; background: var(--popover, #22252a); color: var(--popover-foreground, #e8e9ec); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); outline: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, #e8e9ec) 10%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; padding: 16px 48px 0 16px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 500; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px 16px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-dialog footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #30343b); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted, #202227) 50%, transparent); } .ds-dialog button { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 12px/16px var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif); } .ds-dialog-close { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; width: 28px; padding: 0 !important; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #9297a1); } .ds-dialog-cancel { border: 1px solid var(--border, #30343b); background: var(--background, #111214); color: var(--foreground, #e8e9ec); } .ds-dialog-danger { border: 0; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, #d96a64) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive, #d96a64); } .ds-dialog button:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #c99a45) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Lootbox is a dense desktop instrument that stays calm while the user handles a large and potentially messy asset library. Its interface feels like a well-kept technical workbench: dark, durable surfaces; one warm catalog accent; compact controls; and enough structure to make every action easy to locate without competing with the assets themselves.

The system is quiet, precise, and grounded. It favors information density, stable geometry, direct language, and low-amplitude feedback over decoration. It explicitly rejects gamer neon, glossy spectacle, ornamental gradients, and exaggerated ‘loot’ theming. Tactility belongs to interaction states—hover, focus, press, selection—not to resting surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Compact desktop density with an 11–14px working type range.
Charcoal tonal layers separated by fine steel borders.
Catalog Gold reserved for primary action, focus, progress, and selection.
Assets and previews carry the visual interest; application chrome recedes.
Motion is brief, functional, and removed when reduced motion is requested.

rules.name: The One Warm Signal Rule
rules.body: Catalog Gold is the only positive accent. Do not introduce competing blue, purple, green, or neon interaction colors.

rules.name: The Asset Owns the Color Rule
rules.body: Application chrome remains neutral so thumbnails, textures, video, and models provide the broad color spectrum.

rules.name: The Working Scale Rule
rules.body: Stay inside the implemented 11–16px desktop scale unless a genuinely new reading surface requires otherwise; hierarchy comes from structure and weight before size.

rules.name: The Structural Layer Rule
rules.body: Borders and tone create the resting hierarchy; a shadow means the element is floating or responding to interaction.

dos: Do keep application chrome near-neutral and let asset previews supply the broad color range.
Do use Catalog Gold for the primary action, focus, selection, and progress signals already established by the product.
Do preserve compact 11–14px information density, stable columns, truncation, and monospace technical data.
Do express interaction through subtle tonal hover, visible focus, selected borders, and the existing one-pixel press movement.
Do use borders and tonal layers before reaching for shadows.
Do respect reduced-motion settings and retain text alternatives for icon-only controls.
donts: Don't introduce gamer neon, glossy gradients, ornamental loot imagery, or competing positive accent colors.
Don't place floating shadows on ordinary resting cards or panels.
Don't enlarge corners into soft pill-shaped containers unless the component is genuinely radial or status-like.
Don't inflate headings or spacing until the workspace stops feeling like a compact desktop tool.
Don't use color alone to communicate selection, missing files, errors, or destructive intent.
Don't let application decoration compete with thumbnails, models, textures, waveforms, or video.
